table.title: 中文 · API 参数说明
table.md:
| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | `string` | 是 | — | 用户的唯一标识，由注册接口返回，长度固定为 24 位。 |
| `page_size` | `int` | 否 | `20` | 每页返回的记录条数，取值范围为 1 到 100，超出范围时按边界值处理。 |
| `sort` | `enum` | 否 | `created_at` | 排序字段，可选 `created_at`、`updated_at` 或 `score`。 |
| `include_deleted` | `bool` | 否 | `false` | 是否返回已软删除的数据，仅管理员令牌有效。 |
| `callback_url` | `string` | 否 | — | 异步任务完成后回调的地址，必须为 HTTPS 协议。 |

understanding.purpose: 说明 API 参数的名称、类型、必填性、默认值和用途，帮助读者构造请求。
understanding.reading: 读者先按参数名定位，再横向查看约束和说明；也可能纵向比较必填性或默认值。每行应保持清晰的对应关系。
groups: 参数和类型共同标识字段及其数据格式。
必填和默认值共同说明调用时的取值要求。
说明列解释用途和取值范围，适合获得剩余空间。
keep_intact: 参数名，包括 include_deleted 和 callback_url
默认值，包括 created_at、false 和 20
may_wrap: 说明中的中文短语可自然换行；较长说明形成的行高也可容纳同一行其他单元格。

preferred.name: r0A
preferred.note: 以各短字段的完整显示为底线，把最大空间留给说明，减少长描述的换行。

preferred.name: r1A
preferred.note: 以r0A为基准：前四列恰好容纳各自最长内容，把其余空间留给说明列；总宽623px，符合限制。

acceptable.name: r0B
acceptable.note: 加宽参数名列，为按字段名查找提供更从容的视觉间隔，同时保留较宽的说明列。

acceptable.name: r0C
acceptable.note: 给类型、必填和默认值列更多呼吸空间，强化中间三列的纵向比较，接受说明列增加换行。

bad.name: r1B
bad.note: 必填列减少3px，仍为35px的最长内容保留足够宽度；将空间给说明列，检验能否改善说明的换行。
bad.why: The 必填 header breaks into two lines, making the entire header row taller to gain only 3px for the description column.

rationale: r0A and r1A are identical: they keep the parameter names, types, defaults and headers intact while giving the description column the remaining space. The descriptions fit within three lines, producing a more even row rhythm than r0B or r0C. The small column ranges are conservative estimates, not browser-tested guarantees; widths must still total at most 623px.

general: Preserve identifiers and short headers as intact scanning units.
Give descriptive prose the space left after functional columns have enough width for their contents.
Judge width changes by their effect on the whole row and header, not just the column receiving space.
specific: The 56px 必填 column fits its header, while 53px causes a conspicuous wrap.
The 160px parameter and 114px default columns accommodate the longest identifiers, leaving 216px for descriptions.

tradeoffs: A designer might accept r0B or r0C for more breathing room around identifiers and defaults, at the cost of narrower descriptions and taller rows.
uncertain: The exact limits of equally good widths depend on browser line-breaking thresholds and would need additional renders. The ranges are coupled: increasing one column requires reducing another while respecting the total width.

critique.good: 参数名、类型、必填值和默认值均保持完整；说明列较宽，五个数据行的说明都控制在三行以内，横向对应关系清楚。
critique.problems: 说明仍较拥挤，排序字段的代码标识符占据多行；参数名与默认值列中较短内容旁有较多空白。
critique.cause: 前四列合计407px，已接近保持最长内容完整所需的宽度，留给说明列216px。

critique.good: 参数名列留有充裕空间，所有标识符和表头完整，字段及其约束容易定位。
critique.problems: 参数名列的额外空白没有改善读取，却使多条说明增至四行，行高增加，横向比较也更费力。
critique.cause: 参数列从160px增至180px，说明列相应缩至196px。

critique.good: 类型、必填和默认值列较宽，短值周围较疏朗，表头和代码值均完整。
critique.problems: 约束列的留白与密集的说明列失衡；多条说明增至四行，中文短语与代码值被切成较短的片段。
critique.cause: 类型、必填和默认值列分别增至85、66和128px，使说明列缩至184px。

critique.good: 参数名、类型、必填值和默认值均保持完整，表头处于同一行；说明列自然换行，每行的字段与解释对应清楚。列宽随内容作用分配，便于先定位参数，再横向查阅约束和用途。
critique.problems: 说明列较窄，长说明需要三行，表格因此较高；部分中文短语在行尾被拆开。
critique.cause: 说明列为216px，扣除内边距和边框后仅有195px文本空间。其他列已接近保持最长标识符和表头完整所需的最小宽度，难以在624px视口内进一步扩展说明列。

critique.good: 参数名、类型、默认值及说明中的代码标识符保持完整；说明列比r1A宽3px。
critique.problems: “必填”表头被拆成两行，表头明显高于其他列，破坏横向节奏；说明列增加的空间没有减少正文行高，整表反而更高。
critique.cause: 必填列从56px缩至53px，扣除21px后只剩32px，小于“必填”所需的35px；转给说明列的3px不足以产生有价值的换行改善。

review.method: two fresh-context blind reviews; letters shuffled; includes browser auto layout and equal widths as neutral references

r1B.why: Identifiers and defaults stay intact, and the description has reasonable space, but the 必填 header wraps and HTTPS 协议 is split across lines.

r0B.why: Headers and identifiers remain intact, but extra width in the parameter column leaves descriptions narrow and produces several short lines.

r0A.why: All headers and identifiers stay intact, while the description column has enough room for a clear, balanced reading rhythm.

ref_equal.why: Equal-looking columns waste space in the short fields, split parameter identifiers, and squeeze descriptions into many short lines.

r0C.why: Headers and identifiers stay intact, but the narrow description column makes several rows taller and leaves short final lines.

ref_auto.why: The wide description column reads comfortably and identifiers stay intact, but the 必填 header wraps vertically, weakening the header hierarchy.

raw.unsure: C and F are close: F gives descriptions more room, but C keeps every header on one line.

ref_equal.why: Equal column widths leave the description cramped and split parameter identifiers across lines; tall rows contain large areas of empty space.

r1B.why: Parameter names and defaults stay intact, and the description has useful room, but the 必填 header wraps vertically.

r0B.why: All headers and identifiers stay intact, with clear row structure, though the wide parameter column leaves the description somewhat cramped.

r0C.why: Headers and identifiers remain intact and the columns scan clearly, but the description wraps frequently while the default column has spare space.

ref_auto.why: The generous description column improves sentence flow and keeps identifiers intact, but the 必填 header wraps vertically.

r0A.why: All headers and identifiers stay intact, and the description has enough width for a comfortable rhythm without giving the shorter fields excessive space.

raw.unsure: B and E give the description slightly more room, so the tradeoff between that space and the wrapped 必填 header is partly a matter of judgment.

provenance.note: AI visual design judgement; not a human reading study
